Contributions, not just clicks

04 / The New GTM

Hackathons are the new GTM pipeline

Enterprise go-to-market spends a quarter to get a handful of engineers to open your docs. A hackathon does it in a week: hundreds of builders reading those docs on day one, calling your API by day three, and pushing public repos with your product in the stack by day seven. Same week your competitors are still waiting on a security review.

06 / The Founder

Kunal Kushwaha

Kunal Kushwaha is the Founder of WeMakeDevs, a CNCF Ambassador, and a GitHub Star who has taught millions of developers and built a global community of over 2 million tech enthusiasts.

With a proven track record of scaling startups and developer ecosystems, Kunal has held key leadership roles across the industry, including serving as a Global Field CTO and leading Developer Relations teams at tech unicorns. Throughout his career, he has generated millions in enterprise pipeline, worked alongside leading global enterprises, and organized high-impact tech conferences that bring together thousands in the ecosystem.

Today, Kunal actively advises companies on their cloud-native and AI journeys, guides go-to-market strategies, and helps founders scale active developer ecosystems and raise funding.
